findings.message: Present but unverified: all 32 promised tests exist by exact title (5 in transcript-window.test.ts, 1 in protocol.test.ts:83, 1 in fake-dom.test.ts:113, 2 in render-registry.test.ts:940/980, 12 in transcript-pager.test.ts:109-346, 11 in chat-panel.test.ts:3309-3667), but no build record was supplied, so none of them can be confirmed passing. I did not run the suite. This is not a missing-test finding; run `npx tsx --test` over vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__ to confirm the pass-state before completing the Story.

The testsReaching edges are hollow for the changed production symbols (pageStart, latestWindow, pageBefore, transcriptPagerWebviewSource, postRestored, postLive, appendEvent, followLiveTurn, handleMessage, envelope), because the graph records no edge from anonymous top-level `test(...)` callbacks. I am not reporting these as HIGH not-exercised gaps: a title and import check shows each has tests aimed at it — transcript-window.test.ts has five latestWindow/pageBefore tests, transcript-pager.test.ts:81 evaluates transcriptPagerWebviewSource(), chat-panel.test.ts:3515 asserts the pager is embedded once in the shell, and chat-panel.test.ts:3309-3667 covers the rowIndex writers, load-older handling and the windowed restore. The empty edges are an indexing limit, not evidence of missing coverage; I matched tests by title and import only, without reading the test bodies.
findings.expectationRef: testsReaching edges for transcript-window.ts, transcript-pager.ts and chat-panel.ts symbols

findings.message: Duplication (test scaffolding): this file keeps its own fake DOM (`FakeNode`, `makeNode(tag)`, `fakeDocument`) while the shared `fake-dom.ts` in the same directory already provides a fake node factory that chat-shell.test.ts and transcript-pager.test.ts use. Two fake DOMs can drift, so a registry behaviour could pass against one and fail against the other. Judged from symbol summaries only: no line number is available and the bodies were not compared.

Duplication (test scaffolding): the local helpers `line(s, cls?)`, `maxTop()` and the `Registry` interface repeat same-named helpers in sibling tests (`line` and `Registry` in render-registry.test.ts, `maxTop` in chat-shell.test.ts). They could move into the shared `fake-dom.ts`. Not a production risk. Judged from symbol summaries only: no line number is available and the bodies were not compared.
